bio: This restaurant, nestled among vineyards, is luxury and distinction in its purest form. With a Spanish colonial design, the Awasi Mendoza hotel (with fewer than 20 exclusive rooms) surprises with its picturesque outdoor areas and breathtaking views of the Andes. The restaurant, intimately lit by candlelight, is run by Samanta Lugo, a chef forged in the kitchen of Awasi Iguazú. Revolving around a single tasting menu called Tradicional Asado Argentino, the proposal seeks to reinterpret the flavours of the national and regional cuisine, always with high culinary standards. There is also a vegetarian option available. You can't miss the empanadas with choice cuts of meat, chorizo, black pudding, pork matambrito (flank steak), ribeye steak, barbecued ribs or the grilled vegetables and salads, which are usually based on products from their own vegetable garden.
